items.title: Hal Galper interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 27, 2022
items.q: I was at my old lady’s loft a few months ago and she had put on Miles’ “Relaxin’” album, which was mother’s milk to me when I was young so I knew every solo by heart.

ctx.x: I think a shuffle is the most entrancing beat that — it just like. © Fillius Jazz Archive -17-

Yeah. But I’m feeling it on the off-beats, not the downbeats. And what’s interesting is there’s a whole nother world on the offbeat side. It’s just a completely different world. Things sound completely different. I didn’t realize this but I was at my old lady’s loft a few months ago and she had put on Miles’ “Relaxin’” album, which was mother’s milk to me when I was young so I knew every solo by heart. And I’m listening to this Miles solo but I realized I was listening to it from the offbeat/upbeat side of the…
Do you think Miles — how do I ask this?
